title: Vitalizing British Crab Bubble And Squeak
description: A savory, aerated, British dish featuring crab, nuka-pickle, and other halal-friendly ingredients, traditionally served as a hangover cure. This recipe combines the freshness of the sea with the comfort of a hearty meal.
instructions: Boil the diced potatoes in a large pot of salted water until they are tender, then drain and set aside to cool.
In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat and saute the chopped onions until they are translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
In a large bowl, combine the cooled potatoes, sauteed onions and garlic, crab meat, nuka-pickle, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
In a separate bowl, beat the eggs until they are well mixed, then stir them into the potato and crab mixture until everything is fully incorporated.
Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter in the same skillet used earlier over medium heat, then add the potato and crab mixture and press it down into a flat layer.
Cook the mixture for 4-5 minutes on the first side, or until the bottom is golden brown, then flip it over and cook for an additional 4-5 minutes, or until the other side is also golden brown.
Remove the skillet from the heat and stir in the chopped chives.
Serve the Vitalizing British Crab Bubble And Squeak hot, garnished with additional chives if desired.
